body: Attach chrome.debugger, intercept via Fetch.continueRequest to serve the Cookie header from a private per-session jar, and capture Set-Cookie (HttpOnly included) from Network.responseReceivedExtraInfo — the piece the DNR path can never get, because DNR can set or remove a header but never read one. Handle cookie partitionKey as part of cookie identity. PASS: two tabs stay logged in as different users across a full login, navigate, refresh and reopen cycle, with the real browser cookie jar provably untouched.
title: S3 — CDP cookie interception (core of the recommended engine)
